tools.name: list_portfolio_projects
tools.title: List portfolio projects
tools.description: List Kloche Interiors portfolio projects, optionally filtered by category (Residential, Commercial, Kitchens, Living Spaces).

category.description: Optional category filter. One of: Residential, Commercial, Kitchens, Living Spaces

tools.name: get_portfolio_project
tools.title: Get portfolio project
tools.description: Get full details for one Kloche Interiors portfolio project by its id, including description, scope, gallery images and timeline.

tools.name: list_services
tools.title: List design services
tools.description: List the interior design services Kloche Interiors offers, what each includes, and the studio's project process steps.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.title: Get pricing packages
tools.description: Get Kloche Interiors pricing tiers, the feature comparison table across tiers, and pricing-related FAQs.

tools.name: get_studio_info
tools.title: Get studio contact info
tools.description: Get Kloche Interiors studio details: name, tagline, Nairobi address, phone, email, opening hours and WhatsApp booking link.

tools.name: create_consultation_request
tools.title: Create consultation booking request
tools.description: Build a structured Kloche Interiors consultation booking request from a preferred date/time, budget range and project type. Returns a formatted enquiry summary plus a prefilled WhatsApp link and mailto link the client can use to send it — it does not book anything by itself.

contact.description: Client's phone number or email address for the reply.

projectType.description: Project type, ideally one of: Residential, Commercial, Kitchens, Living Spaces (other descriptions are accepted).

budgetRange.description: Budget range, ideally one of: Under KES 200,000 | KES 200,000 – 1M | KES 1M – 3M | Over KES 3M | Not sure yet.

preferredDate.description: Preferred consultation date, e.g. '2026-08-14' or 'week of 10 August'.

preferredTime.description: Preferred time of day, e.g. '10:00' or 'weekday mornings'.

notes.description: Optional extra context about the space or brief.
